// Acceptance for task (b): the signature, and a Host that passes a facet of a wider store.
import type { ModuleContext } from "@get-modular/resources";
import { createStore, type ListenerError } from "@get-modular/observation";
import { createCatalogModule } from "./b-catalog.js";
import type { CatalogDeps, CatalogProduct } from "./b-catalog.types.js";

const signature: (deps: CatalogDeps, context: ModuleContext) => Promise<CatalogProduct> = createCatalogModule;
type HostSettings = { readonly region: string; readonly theme: string };
declare const context: ModuleContext;
declare const reportError: (report: ListenerError) => undefined;
const host = createStore<HostSettings>({ region: "eu", theme: "light" }, { name: "settings", resources: context.resources, reportError });
void signature({ settings: host.readonly() }, context);
